jobs.title: Event Security Specialist - Flexible Part-Time | Weekly Pay
jobs.description:

Flexible part-time scheduling fits your lifestyle, with weekly pay and a mandatory security license. Duties include screening guests, directing traffic, and protecting assets throughout events.

The role requires 18+ years for unarmed positions, a high school diploma, and compliance with background checks and drug screening. Flexibility in scheduling and opportunities for growth are highlighted in this posting.

jobs.title: Front Desk Security Officer — Part-Time, Flexible Shifts
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Officer – Front Desk Enhanced Part Time in Dallas, TX. This role offers flexible, reliable hours at an assigned site with the option to pick up additional shifts through our scheduling platform, providing income stability and hands-on experience in the security industry.

The position pays $21.50 per hour with a fixed schedule and opportunities to grow into a full-time schedule; prior access control and customer service experience is preferred.

jobs.title: Concierge Security Officer — Grocery Store (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
GardaWorld Security Services is seeking a Part Time Security Guard in a Concierge role in Dallas. The ideal candidate excels in customer service and can engage visitors while maintaining security across office towers, hotels, and shopping centers.

Experience in security is not required, though prior badging is a plus. Everyday duties include access control, incident response, and writing reports. Uniforms are provided; DailyPay is available for GardaWorld employees.
